lanes.lane_objective: Build AuditContext and product-surface input-spec authority for the verified incremental query graph.
lanes.macro_lane_rationale: This lane owns input authority and cache invalidation semantics that must be resolved before downstream hot-loop and telemetry lanes can safely consume affected-set or verified-local reuse claims.
acceptance_scope: AuditContext or product-surface input specs drive changed inputs and invalidation reasons.
Verified-local cache keys include current input digests plus law, schema, fixture, validator, argument, environment, and cache-mode versions.
Real current-candidate command behavior or verified current-input reuse is reported with source-local claim limits.

lane_size_evidence.independent_outcome: The lane can return a standalone source-local commit proving input-spec and cache-invalidation authority without modifying coverage, namespace, command-roundtrip, or current-state ownership.
work_units: bind cache keys to command and authority versions
add stale and mutation fixtures for input equivalence
prove one real source-local command path
lane_size_evidence.why_not_parent_inline: The parent is now orchestrator/reconciler and this implementation can proceed in a disjoint worktree without blocking root monitoring.
lane_size_evidence.why_not_smaller: Input specs, cache keys, and invalidation proof must be changed together or downstream lanes would consume inconsistent authority.

parent_orchestrator_state.action: Do not merge or extend Lane 1 until parent creates/expands a hot-loop executor or telemetry-row ownership lane for nodes/measurement/**.

teardown.reason: Active implementation lane; teardown is forbidden until parent accepts or abandons lane output.

lanes.lane_objective: Build coverage lineage and routine coverage intelligence while preserving strict exact coverage authority.
lanes.macro_lane_rationale: Coverage lineage is independent from live-loop input specs and active-surface topology, but it blocks fast-loop honesty because routine coverage cannot substitute for strict boundary proof.
acceptance_scope: Strict full-clean coverage remains the only exact coverage boundary proof.
Routine coverage feedback carries lineage, equivalence, cache class, and routine-only claim limits.
Coverage-theater and stale/warm substitution fixtures fail closed.

lane_size_evidence.independent_outcome: The lane can return a standalone source-local commit for coverage lineage without modifying live-loop input specs, namespace authority, or command-roundtrip ownership.
work_units: separate strict and routine coverage proof surfaces
fail stale or warm strict-proof substitution
prove one current-candidate coverage behavior or claim-limited routine reuse
lane_size_evidence.why_not_parent_inline: The parent must preserve orchestration quality and coverage lineage has a wide enough source footprint to need an owned implementation lane.
lane_size_evidence.why_not_smaller: Coverage command, audit, claim semantics, and fixtures must agree or the lane would produce contradictory proof surfaces.

parent_orchestrator_state.finding: Lane 2 is clean at d30fbf1df105887dfd3927b649035f6ea46b4c9b and added a useful coverage_manifest_stale_source_path guard, but the actual stale coverage manifest references remain in .harness/coverage-manifest.json and templates/.harness/coverage-manifest.json.
parent_orchestrator_state.action: Parent sent a goal-bound continuation to repair those two coverage manifests under explicit ownership expansion before acceptance. Lane output is not merged or accepted.

teardown.reason: Active implementation lane; teardown is forbidden until parent accepts or abandons lane output.

lanes.lane_objective: Build product-semantic active-surface inventory and authority-topology enforcement.
lanes.macro_lane_rationale: Active-surface authority is independent from coverage lineage and live-loop input specs, but it controls namespace, duplicate authority, alias, orphan, and row-shape theater risks before broader Gate 92 fitting.
acceptance_scope: Every active package-owned surface has a typed product role and authority level.
Duplicate authority, orphan surfaces, compatibility-alias overclaim, broad exceptions, and row-shape-only passes fail closed.
Real current-candidate CLI/source-audit/namespace execution detects actual package-owned surfaces.

lane_size_evidence.independent_outcome: The lane can return a standalone source-local commit for active-surface and namespace authority without modifying coverage or live-loop input-spec ownership.
work_units: harden product-role inventory over active surfaces
detect duplicate and alias authority escapes
add orphan and row-shape-only failure fixtures
prove current namespace or active-surface command behavior
lane_size_evidence.why_not_parent_inline: The parent must remain reconciler, and active-surface authority spans enough namespace and law surfaces to need an owned implementation lane.
lane_size_evidence.why_not_smaller: Source, schema, fixture, and package-surface ownership must be consistent or duplicate/orphan enforcement becomes theater.

pre_merge_lane_gate.trigger: lane reports ready_for_review with clean worktree and source-local not-readiness commit
required_inputs: lane production proof or verified current-input reuse with claim limits
pre_merge_lane_gate.claim_ceiling_impact: lane output cannot be accepted, merged, fitted, validated, ready, complete, or used for update_goal until this gate passes

post_merge_integration_gate.trigger: parent merges or cherry-picks accepted lane output into root
post_merge_integration_gate.claim_ceiling_impact: merged lane output remains source-local and cannot support readiness, release, completion, final packet, install/cache, registry/reviewer, or update_goal claims

final_all_lanes_gate.trigger: all first-wave Phase 2 lanes are accepted or explicitly abandoned
required_inputs: focused red/green/tamper proof for touched semantics
final_all_lanes_gate.claim_ceiling_impact: Gate 92 remains open and source-local only until all required production proof surfaces reconcile
